scope: decision register round 2: wrapped sync seed, typed pairing code, visible unreadable rows, migration guidance, audit origin, baseline marker

A2_sync_seed.change: SeedVault wraps the 32-byte Ed25519 seed with a non-exportable Android Keystore AES-256-GCM key (prefs key sync_seed_wrapped); the plaintext sync_seed is migrated once and removed; MainActivity and SyncTransport both go through the vault
A2_sync_seed.failure_mode: if the Keystore key is gone the seed is not silently replaced, because peers still hold the old pairing; it logs and returns an empty seed
A2_sync_seed.limits: a full app-data clone that also carries the Keystore cannot be defended against; this removes the plaintext copy, not the identity model

A4_pairing_code.change: both pairing paths require the user to type the 6-digit code shown on the other device; SyncPairing.confirm compares constant-time and rejects empty codes
A4_pairing_code.limits: the Java fallback code is still derived from the two public fingerprints, so a peer that relays both codes can still pass; the Rust SAS path binds the transfer keys

C2_unreadable_rows.change: the home summary shows 'N records cannot be decrypted on this device' in red as soon as a row is skipped, instead of hiding the state in settings

B4_migration_guidance.change: the data section states that device migration goes through the encrypted archive and why backups/device transfer are excluded

B2_audit_origin.change: schema 15 adds audit.origin; local rows are 'local', archive-imported rows are 'imported' and are rendered with a [imported] marker and in the TSV export
B2_audit_origin.why: imported history previously looked identical to local evidence

A3_baseline_marker.change: the audit page permanently shows that the anchor baseline was rebuilt once, instead of a one-off toast

items.audit_tsv: tab/CR/newline are replaced and formula-leading characters are quoted so an imported event cannot inject columns or formulas

device_evidence.migration: schema 14 -> 15 on the Pixel 6a; audit page reports 10 events chain intact and shows the rebuilt-baseline notice
